fabs.definition: Fabs the company operates in the location, out of "one 150mm wafer fab, six 200mm wafer fabs, nine 300mm wafer fabs, and seven advanced backend fabs". The 20-F spells these counts out in words. Its fab locations (e.g. "Hsinchu Science Park") may be drawn wider than the employee table's rows of the same name: the fab sentence places no fab in Taoyuan, Miaoli or Kaohsiung, yet the fab table puts Fab 22 (Kaohsiung) in the Southern Taiwan Science Park and the employee table lists Kaohsiung separately, so fab and employee counts on one row need not cover the same area.

notes: All figures are from the 2025 Form 20-F on sec.gov (filed Apr 2026; TSMC's own sites block scripted fetches). Employees: Item 6.D table of full-time employees by location, Dec 31, 2025 (total 90,557); the seven Taiwan locations (Taipei City is new in 2025, 14 employees) are recorded as regions (countries ["TW"]) because the table has no Taiwan total, and none was summed. North America and Europe are the table's own groupings (no country list). Fabs: the 20-F gives fab counts in words ("nine of our fabs are located in the Hsinchu Science Park, two fabs are located in the Central Taiwan Science Park, seven fabs are located in the Southern Taiwan Science Park, two fabs are located in the United States, one fab is located in Shanghai, one fab is located in Nanjing, and one fab is located in Japan"); quotes carry a bracketed [nine = 9] style annotation. These counts include advanced backend fabs (seven, up from five). The fab sentence's areas may not match the employee table's rows of the same name: the fab table places Fab 22 (Kaohsiung, in production since 2025) in the Southern Taiwan Science Park, while the employee table lists Kaohsiung Nanzih separately, and Taoyuan City and Miaoli County show employees but no fab, so a row's fab count and employee count may not describe exactly the same area. Shanghai and Nanjing (one fab each) are shown as sites, not summed into a China fab count. No U.S. state rows: the U.S. fabs are one in Washington State (Fab 11) and one in Arizona (Fab 21), shown as sites with state codes; no per-state employee or investment figures are published in the 20-F. Fab 24 (Dresden) is not yet operating; Fab 20 (Hsinchu, 2nm, 2025) is in the fab table but not listed as a site. Site descriptions take year/wafer size/technology from the 20-F fab table (as of Feb 28, 2026; technology as of 2025 year-end).
